m1.typescript: m1 a well formed read only tool is approved and leaves an audit line

e1.typescript: e1 a description needs at least the minimum number of words

e2.typescript: e2 the timeout and the memory may equal their limits and not exceed them

e3.typescript: e3 a name is lower case snake case of at most sixty four characters

e4.typescript: e4 forbidden calls in the code refuse the tool and are all listed in order

e5.typescript: e5 a permission the code uses without declaring it or a denied one refuses the tool

e6.typescript: e6 a declared write is approved only with a gate and a read alone is approved outright

e7.typescript: e7 a refusal beats a revision and a revision beats a gate

e8.typescript: e8 the permissions the code uses are reported in alphabetical order

wrong-description-inclusive.defect: calls a description too short when it has exactly the minimum number of words

wrong-timeout-inclusive.defect: flags a timeout that equals the limit

wrong-memory-inclusive.defect: flags a memory request that equals the limit

wrong-name-too-long.defect: rejects a name of exactly sixty four characters

wrong-forbidden-first-only.defect: lists only the first forbidden call

wrong-undeclared-ignored.defect: does not refuse a permission that the code uses and the proposal does not declare

wrong-denied-ignored.defect: does not refuse a denied permission that the proposal declares

wrong-gate-skipped.defect: approves a declared write outright with no gate

wrong-revise-before-refuse.defect: sends a refused tool back for revision because it also has a finding

wrong-used-unsorted.defect: reports the permissions in the order of the scan table and not alphabetically
